n.exclusions: Excluded 1673 for <45 seconds on Crick text and another 595 for failed reading check. Results paragraph prints n = 2820, but group n=1297 and 1525 and protocol deviations explicitly give 2822; retained explicit final sample.
n.location: Post-replication report p.3, Unplanned protocol deviations
n.quote: Unplanned Protocol Deviations: The survey was reprogrammed in Qualtrics using screenshots of the original Soci Survey, kindly provided by the original authors. We have a sample size of 2822 participants, which is above our aim of 2702 participants. There were no deviations from the protocol. Other information: Since the experiment was expected to take, on average, 10–11 minutes, we had a show-up fee of $1.5. We excluded (as preregistered) participants who spent less than 45 seconds on the page where the Crick text was displayed (n = 1673 excluded) and those who failed a reading check in the form of a multiple-choice question (an additional n = 595 excluded).

es.quote: The standardized effect size (Cohen’s d) is d = 0.138 (95% CI [0.064, 0.211]).

p.quote: This difference of 0.166 (se = 0.045) was tested using an independent-samples t-test assuming equal variances (t(2820) = 3.653, p < 0.001; n = 2820).

reported_success.quote: Discussion: Given the criteria and procedure outlined above, the hypothesis of interest has been replicated at a significance level of p < 0.05.

notes: Original and replication evaluated separately. Replication statistics are as printed in the primary authors’ post-replication report.
